text: Let's be honest: Siri hasn't been much help with your apps.
Apple's rebuilding it as Siri AI. It's in preview for developers now, and it can call your app's tools, if you set them up right. Most developers won't, at least for a while.
Syrup AI Kit makes Siri adoption smooth for developers, and gives your users a much richer experience. It's an open-source repo you can add by hand, or give to your coding agent as a plugin.
Its discovery skill reads your app's screens and data layer, finds the actions people would ask Siri for, and writes the Swift that answers.
Set up right, each tool tells Siri what your app can do, giving people a bunch of new ways to use it.
Syrup AI Kit. Get your apps ready for Siri AI.
